payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the original blue mug from the source visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image, or does the edit show concrete but incomplete rightward displacement of that mug?
condition.criteria: Compare the SOURCE and EDITED images, tracking the source light-blue mug by its location, appearance, and scene context. The endpoint is fully achieved only when the same source mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones; a different mug on the right does not count. For incomplete fulfillment, require concrete visual evidence that the source mug itself has been displaced toward the headphones, such as a changed position or a remnant/transition visibly consistent with movement from its former location. A blue blur remaining at the former location alone, without reliable evidence of displacement, is not enough to assert partial progress. If the blur, changed appearance, or scene changes do not allow reliable judgment of continuity or movement, treat the evidence as insufficient rather than inferring either movement or no movement.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: compare the blue blurred shape at the mug’s former left position, the white mugs near and to the right of the headphones, and their locations and appearance against the source. Do not identify either white mug as the source mug without visual evidence of continuity; assess whether the source mug itself shows concrete displacement toward or to the right of the headphones.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
condition.zero_when: There is no concrete visual evidence that the source blue mug was displaced toward the right of the headphones; a stationary blur at its former location or a different mug on the right does not count. If continuity or displacement cannot be reliably judged, the evidence is insufficient rather than established zero fulfillment.
condition.half_when: The source mug is not shown to have reached the right of the headphones, but concrete visual evidence supports that this same mug was displaced toward them; a specific remaining positional deficiency is visible. Do not use a blur alone as proof of movement when its relation to the source mug is indeterminate.
condition.full_when: The source blue mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image.
